edgeTopologyFollowup.methodology: Every fit receives pixels only. Clean-tree input pixels are rendered from an approximate straight-span annotation of the published template, not an exact digitization. Edge-noise tests flip 20 of 160000 pixels. Original input remains the final accuracy reference. Crop overrides are diagnostic manual annotations fixed before fitting, not surveyed truth; percentages against different classified crops are not directly interchangeable.
